newsitem.title: USA: Fed intervenes via 7-day system RPs, more possible.
newsitem.headline: Fed intervenes via 7-day system RPs, more possible.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added reserves to the banking system via a round of seven-day fixed-system repurchase agreements on Friday.

While not completely unexpected, some econmomists thought the Fed had adequately addressed its add need in previous sessions. And, as the Fed had intervened twice in the prior two sessions, the possibility of another operation on Friday existed.
Federal funds were quoted at 5.50 percent, right at the Fed's current official target level.
